name: Cable Rope Hammer Curl
description: A hammer curl performed with a rope attachment on a low cable pulley. The cable provides constant tension throughout the movement and the neutral grip (palms facing each other) targets the brachialis and brachioradialis to a greater degree than a supinated curl, building arm thickness and elbow flexor strength.

execution.starting_position: Stand facing a low cable pulley, holding a rope attachment with a neutral grip (palms facing each other).
execution.setup_instructions: Attach a rope to the low cable pulley. Stand back enough for the cable to be taut with arms extended.
steps: Step 1: Keeping the upper arms stationary at your sides, curl the rope upward.
Step 2: Pull the ends of the rope apart slightly at the top of the movement.
Step 3: Lower back to full arm extension in a controlled manner.
Step 4: Repeat without letting the upper arms swing forward.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the curl. Inhale on the return.
common_mistakes: Swinging the upper arms to generate momentum
Not fully extending at the bottom
safety_considerations: Keep the upper arms pinned to the sides throughout
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension at the bottom. Full flexion at the top.
coaching_cues: Split the rope at the top
